themes.title: Capital requirements and ratios
themes.html:
• Standardized CET1 ratio: 12.0% (FY2018) → 15.7% (FY2024) → 14.6% (FY2025).
  • SCB: 3.3% (2020) → 4.0% (2022) → 2.9% (2023) → 3.3% (2024) → 2.5% (2025, held through September 30, 2027).
  • GSIB Method 2 surcharge: 3.5% through 2022 → 4.0% (2023) → 4.5% (2024–2026).
  • Stated CET1 target: 12% (FY2020), 13.0%/13.5% (FY2022), "no longer meaningful" (FY2023), none after.
  • Advanced ratios became binding at December 31, 2025.

themes.title: Guidance figures by filing
themes.html:
• NII guidance: in excess of $58bn (for 2019) → approximately $103bn (for 2026).
  • Adjusted expense guidance: less than $66bn (for 2019) → approximately $105bn (for 2026).
  • Card NCO rate guidance first appears in FY2022 (~2.6%); FY2025 guides ~3.4%.
  • "market dependent" attached to expense guidance from FY2022.

themes.title: Balance sheet and acquisitions
themes.html:
• Total assets: $2.62tn (2018) → $4.42tn (2025).
  • Deposits: $1.47tn (2018) → $2.56tn (2025); uninsured estimate first disclosed FY2021 ($1,489.6bn), $1,558.6bn in FY2025.
  • First Republic (May 2023): final bargain purchase gain $2.9bn; FDIC settlement gain $588m (1Q25).
  • Apple Card forward purchase commitment (December 30, 2025): ~$104bn estimated credit exposure at closing.

themes.title: Structural and naming changes
themes.html:
• Risk-factor categories: 13 → 14 (COVID-19, FY2020) → 13 (FY2022) → 12 (Legal merged into "Legal and Regulatory", FY2025).
  • Segments: CIB and CB combined into the Commercial & Investment Bank, effective 2Q24.
  • "JPMorganChase" as one word: 3 occurrences (FY2023) → 717 (FY2024).
  • "Headcount" metric renamed "Employees" (FY2023).

themes.title: Terms reduced in FY2024–FY2025
themes.html:
• "diversity": 9 (FY2021–FY2022) → 0 (FY2025); "Diversity, equity and inclusion" sub-heading replaced by "Workforce composition" (FY2024).
  • "climate": 50 (FY2023) → 31 (FY2025); "Climate Risk Management" 5 → 0.
  • "ESG": 11 (FY2022) → 2 (FY2025).
  • Litigation headed matters: 12 (FY2023) → 7 (FY2025).

themes.title: Terms added in FY2023–FY2025
themes.html:
• "AI" as a word: 0 through FY2024 → 23 (FY2025); stand-alone AI risk factor added FY2025.
  • "agentic", "stablecoin", "tokeniz-": first appear FY2025.
  • "Fair Access to Banking" litigation heading added FY2025.
  • Buyback authorization raised to $50bn (July 1, 2025).
